name: 77904 · Victoria, TX
findings: ZIP 77904 (Victoria) has 90 nonprofit organizations. 46 of them (51%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 38 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (41% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 77904 (Victoria) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list volunteering
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 77904 (Victoria) list volunteering on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 70% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 21 organizations here; 40% of all organizations here have no identified type.
